narration.full_text: Welcome to our journey into the world of trigonometry! In this section, we'll lay the groundwork for understanding how angles and sides of triangles relate to each other. Our main goal is to define and identify the six fundamental trigonometric ratios: sine, cosine, tangent, cosecant, secant, and cotangent. You'll learn how to apply these ratios to solve various problems involving right-angled triangles, which are crucial for many real-world applications. We'll also explore and utilize reciprocal trigonometric identities, which are powerful tools for simplifying expressions and solving equations. Finally, we'll work through several examples, showing you how to find all trigonometric ratios when given just one, and how to verify important identities. By the end, you'll have a solid foundation in these essential concepts.
